strings.ui.mob.line.morning.1: Morning. The lecture hall feels far today.
strings.ui.mob.line.lunch.0: I bet the cafeteria is packed already.
strings.ui.mob.line.lunch.1: I'll eat on the mall bench.
strings.ui.mob.line.afternoon.0: Which building is the next lab in?
strings.ui.mob.line.afternoon.1: That report is due this week...
strings.ui.mob.line.evening.0: Good work today. See you tomorrow.
strings.ui.mob.line.night.0: The lab lights are still on.
strings.ui.mob.line.night.1: I should still make the last train.
strings.quest.q_coffee.title: A Break on the Mall
strings.quest.q_coffee.summary: Kanamachi Sora caught you in front of the coffee shop on the first floor of Kyoso Hall. Before her latte goes cold, you're walking together to a bench on the campus mall.
strings.quest.q_coffee.reward: You swapped contact details with Sora
strings.quest.q_coffee.s1: Go to the bench on the campus mall
strings.quest.q_gym.title: Sixty Seconds to the Gym
strings.quest.q_gym.summary: According to the professor, the gym gets locked in one minute. Turn north off the mall and sprint with Shift and you should make it. If you miss it, talk to the professor to try again.
strings.quest.q_gym.reward: You got a look inside the gymnasium arena
strings.quest.q_gym.s1: Dash into the gymnasium within 60 seconds
strings.quest.q_library.title: Inari-senpai's Reserved Book
strings.quest.q_library.summary: By the shallow reflecting pool that wraps around the library like a moat, Hananoki Inari asked you to pick up a reserved book. The library is the glass building with the octagonal 600-seat hall on its roof.
strings.quest.q_library.reward: Inari gave you a pressed-flower bookmark
strings.quest.q_library.s1: Enter the library and pick up the reserved book
strings.quest.q_library.s2: Deliver the book to Inari by the reflecting pool
strings.quest.q_lunch.title: The Cafeteria's Busiest Hour
strings.quest.q_lunch.summary: The first-floor cafeteria in Research Building 2 has 1,400 seats. At the lunch peak, they've run out of milk. Buy milk at the convenience store on the first floor of Kyoso Hall and bring it to Nakagawa Kaname.
strings.quest.q_lunch.reward: Kaname threw in an extra plate of the daily special
strings.quest.q_lunch.s1: Buy milk at the convenience store on the first floor of Kyoso Hall
strings.quest.q_lunch.s2: Deliver it to Kaname in the first-floor cafeteria of Research Building 2
strings.quest.q_orientation.title: First Day on Campus
strings.quest.q_orientation.summary: You walked up Rikadai Street from Kanamachi Station. Once through the main gate, follow the campus mall, 250 metres straight from southwest to northeast. The professor should be waiting in front of the lecture building.
strings.quest.q_orientation.reward: You've more or less got the campus map in your head
strings.quest.q_orientation.s1: Enter campus through the main gate on Rikadai Street
strings.quest.q_orientation.s3: Greet the professor in front of the lecture building
strings.quest.q_park.title: Lost and Found in Mirai Park
strings.quest.q_park.summary: Katsushika Niijuku Mirai Park sits right next to campus. Between the lawn and the dirt field, five Rikadai-green leaves are scattered about.
strings.quest.q_park.reward: You gathered all five leaves and pressed them
strings.quest.q_park.s1: Collect five Rikadai-green leaves in Niijuku Mirai Park
strings.quest.q_sq_greenhouse.title: Greenhouse Watering Duty
strings.quest.q_sq_greenhouse.summary: The professor forgot greenhouse duty. Head to the gabled glass greenhouse east of Experiment Building 2 and water the pots on the growing benches.
strings.quest.q_sq_greenhouse.reward: The professor gave you a sprout in a small pot
strings.quest.q_sq_greenhouse.s2: Water the pots on the growing benches
strings.quest.q_sq_greenhouse.s3: Report back to the professor in front of the lecture building
strings.quest.q_sq_lab_notebook.title: Sora's Lab Notebook
strings.quest.q_sq_lab_notebook.summary: Sora left a notebook in Experiment Building 1. It should be next to the fume hood in the far lab. Fetch it, and call it thanks for the latte.
strings.quest.q_sq_lab_notebook.reward: Sora gave you a test-tube charm
strings.quest.q_sq_lab_notebook.s2: Find Sora's goggles and notebook in the far lab
strings.quest.q_sq_lab_notebook.s3: Bring them to Sora in front of Kyoso Hall
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.title: Lost in the Cafeteria
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.summary: The lunch rush is over and a student ID turned up near the ticket machines. Kaname asks you to trace the owner from the ticket machines to the tray return.
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.reward: Kaname now knows you as a cafeteria regular
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.s1: Check the ticket machines on the first floor of Research Building 2
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.s2: Look for a clue about the owner at the tray return
strings.quest.q_sq_lost_card.s3: Hand the student ID to Kaname
strings.quest.q_sq_night_walk.title: The Way Home
strings.quest.q_sq_night_walk.summary: After the sunset, once it's past 19:00, walk the lamplit mall back to the main gate. The end of the day.
strings.quest.q_sq_night_walk.reward: You walked the whole day through
strings.quest.q_sq_night_walk.s1: Return to the main gate after 19:00
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.title: Campus Photo Walk
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.summary: Walk the mall and visit three of the spots where the campus looks its best. A tripod mark on the ground shows where to stand.
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.reward: You became a provisional member of the photo club
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.s1: Stand at the photo spot looking down the mall
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.s2: Stand at the photo spot facing the Kyoso Hall louvres
strings.quest.q_sq_photo_walk.s3: Stand at the photo spot by the reflecting pool
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.title: The Stray Book
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.summary: A book Inari returned never made it back to the shelf. Search from the far end of the open stacks to the study carrels, then tell the counter.
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.reward: Inari gave you a second pressed-flower bookmark
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.s2: Search the far end of the open stacks
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.s4: Tell the counter where the book is
strings.quest.q_sq_stray_book.s5: Report to Inari by the reflecting pool
strings.quest.q_sunset.title: Sunset on the Reflecting Pool
strings.quest.q_sunset.summary: After 18:00, the sun slips under the library's deep eaves and across the pool, and for a moment the whole campus turns orange. Be in front of the pool at that hour.
strings.quest.q_sunset.reward: You saw the best view of the day
strings.quest.q_sunset.s1: Go to the library's reflecting pool after 18:00
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sunset.0: Did you see it? The pool at six.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sunset.1: Those deep eaves cut the low sun, so only the water keeps the orange. It only goes that colour a few times a year.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sunset.3: No, no. Things like that are prettiest in the memory of whoever was there.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_done.0: Thank you, that's a real help. It took three days to get this out of the closed stacks.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_done.1: Here's your thanks. A pressed-flower bookmark. Made from a leaf that fell by the edge of this pool.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_done.2: Are you sure I can have it?
strings.dialogue.inari.t_done.3: Of course. Next time it's your turn to lend it to someone.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_active.0: It should be reserved at the back of the counter under 'Hananoki'.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_active.1: The library is just across this pool. The building with the enormous roof and the octagonal dome on top. There's a 600-seat hall inside, apparently.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_active.2: Once you've got it, come back here. I'm not moving from the edge of this pond.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_start.0: Hey, new kid. ...Well, you've got a new-kid face. I'm right, aren't I.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_start.1: Sorry to ask, but could you pick up a book for me at the library? I can't leave this spot right now.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_start.3: This pool, see, only reflects the whole library when there's no wind. And it's been dead calm since morning.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_start.4: ...Is that not a good enough reason?
strings.dialogue.inari.t_idle.0: This pond isn't even ten centimetres deep. Fall in and you just get wet.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_idle.1: Take it from someone who has fallen in. I'm not wrong.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_start.0: You pressed the leaves. ...Say, could I ask one more thing?
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_start.1: A book I returned last week never made it back to the shelf. Apparently someone's left it somewhere in the building.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_start.2: Somewhere in the building is a lot of ground.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_start.3: From the back of the open stacks to the study carrels. When you find it, tell the counter where.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_active.0: Fourteen rows of shelves. Start from the very back. Failing that, one of the 66 study carrels.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_active.1: When you find it, tell the counter. Then come back here.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_done.1: Here, a second bookmark. This one's from a park leaf. One of the five you gathered.
strings.dialogue.inari.t_sq_stray_book_done.3: No. A bookmark is for using. The thing you take care of is the book.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_done.0: You saved me! Seriously, you saved me! Run out of milk at the peak and this place turns into hell.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_done.1: Here, an extra plate of the daily special. Sit wherever's free.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_done.2: There are 1,400 seats. Does it really fill up?
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_done.3: From 12:20 to 12:40, yes. Those twenty minutes are a war.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_active.0: The convenience store is on the first floor of Kyoso Hall, the glass side. Look for the blue, green and white sign.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_active.1: Milk. One carton is fine. You don't have to run, but hurry.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_start.0: Hey! You there, are your hands free?
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_start.1: This is the Research Building 2 cafeteria, 1,400 seats. And right now is when every one of them fills up.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_start.2: And we're out of milk. Could you buy some at the convenience store on the first floor of Kyoso Hall? It's on us.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_start.3: Um, yes, I can do that.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_start.4: Thanks! Tell whoever's in an apron and they'll let you through.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_idle.0: The window seats are the good ones. They face west, so it's glaring in the evening, mind.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_idle.1: The upper floors are labs. So every now and then someone comes down for a set meal still in their lab coat.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_start.0: Hey, one more favour. Somebody dropped a student ID over by the ticket machines.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_start.1: The peak just ended and I'm stuck clearing up. Could you check from the ticket machines to the tray return for any clue who it belongs to?
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_start.3: Sometimes there's a chopstick case with a name on it left on a finished tray, that kind of thing.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_active.0: The ticket machines are along the left wall as you come in, the row of six. The tray return is at the far end on the opposite side.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_active.1: The serving counter runs 38 metres, so just walk straight along it and you'll get there.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_done.0: Thanks. Looks like the owner was someone eating lunch up on the second-floor gallery. They just came to collect it.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_done.1: You're a regular now, you know. I've got your face memorised.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_done.2: This is only my second time here.
strings.dialogue.kaname.t_sq_lost_card_done.3: Twice makes a regular. Cafeteria rules.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_done.0: You made it. Well, I'm impressed.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_done.1: The arena has a high ceiling, you know. Light from the high side windows lays long bands on the floor, but only in the afternoon.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_done.2: ...I was too busy running to notice.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_done.3: Hm. Then next time, walk over and have a look.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_active.0: I've asked the key holder to wait one more minute. Sixty seconds, starting from here.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_active.1: Turn north off the mall and you'll reach the gym. Hold Shift and run.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_start.0: Ah, good timing. The gym key holder says they're locking up in one minute.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_start.1: Go and see the inside. You only get to see the facilities at the entrance ceremony otherwise.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_gym_start.3: Sixty seconds. Well, with your legs it should be enough.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_welcome.0: Good morning. You're one of the Information Engineering students. You were on the list.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_welcome.1: This mall is 250 metres long. From the Kanamachi Station end in the southwest to the library in the northeast, one straight line.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_welcome.2: If you get lost, just walk on these paving stones. You'll end up somewhere.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_welcome.4: Good. Then today, walk wherever you like.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_idle.0: The southwest corner of the lecture building, see how the wall curves? That's the grand stair hall inside.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_idle.1: Design is simply the paths people walk, given a shape.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_start.0: Incidentally, I was on greenhouse watering duty today. It had entirely slipped my mind.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_start.1: East of Experiment Building 2 you'll see a gabled glass roof. That's the greenhouse. Would you water the pots on the growing benches for me?
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_start.3: It is. Which is why you'll be rewarded.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_active.0: The greenhouse is east of Experiment Building 2. The tap for the watering pipe is on the right as you go in.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_active.1: Two rows of pots. Water every one. Miss a single pot and it's me who gets told off.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_done.1: A pot that's just sprouted in the greenhouse. Only two leaves so far. What seed it is, you'll find out by growing it.
strings.dialogue.prof.t_sq_greenhouse_done.3: That wouldn't be much of an experiment, would it.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_done.1: ...This bench gets the best sun on the whole mall. There's a gap in the zelkova trees, right here.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_done.3: I'm in pharmacy. Most things, you change one condition and try again, over and over.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_active.0: The bench is about halfway along the mall. Where the paving turns to checkerboard.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_active.1: The latte's got maybe seven minutes before it goes cold. I'll go on ahead.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_start.0: ...Hey, two things. One, this latte is hot. Two, I can't sit in that chair over there right now.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_start.2: The first-floor coffee shop opens onto the learning square, and everyone's in there doing seminar consultations. Sit alone and you get pulled in.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_start.3: So come with me to the bench on the mall. Before it goes cold.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_idle.0: See the white louvres lined up vertically on this building? They're there to cut the sunlight, apparently.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_idle.1: So inside it's the same brightness all day. The downside is you lose all sense of time.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_start.0: ...So, um, one more thing. I left my notebook in Experiment Building 1.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_start.1: The far lab, next to the fume hood. Left it there with my goggles.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_start.3: If I go now, the professor catches me and it turns into the next experiment. I wouldn't get away for half an hour.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_active.0: Experiment Building 1 is just west of the greenhouse. Go down the corridor, the lab is at the far end.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_active.1: The notebook has nothing on the cover. Look for the goggles.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_done.1: A test-tube charm. The blue stuff inside isn't real, don't worry.
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_done.2: If it were real, what would be in it?
strings.dialogue.sora.t_sq_lab_notebook_done.3: ...The result of changing one condition and trying, over and over.
strings.item.c_gate_keyring.name: Main Gate Keyring
strings.item.c_gate_keyring.hint: Just inside the main gate off Rikadai Street. Something glints at the base of the hedge.
strings.item.c_mall_pin.name: Cobblestone Pin Badge
strings.item.c_mall_pin.hint: Where the mall's paving turns to a checkerboard. Wedged in a joint between stones.
strings.item.c_bench_coin.name: Coin Under the Bench
strings.item.c_bench_coin.hint: The sunniest bench on the mall. Don't sit, look underneath.
strings.item.c_pond_marble.name: Reflecting Pool Marble
strings.item.c_pond_marble.hint: The east rim of the moat around the library. Ten centimetres down, the same colour as the sky.
strings.item.c_park_acorn.name: Mirai Park Acorn
strings.item.c_park_acorn.hint: The lawn in Niijuku Mirai Park. Look again where the Rikadai-green leaves were lying.
strings.item.c_park_disc.name: Rikadai-Green Flying Disc
strings.item.c_park_disc.hint: Toward the dirt field side of the park. Someone threw it and never came back for it.
strings.item.c_shrine_bell.name: Little Inari Bell
strings.item.c_shrine_bell.hint: East of campus, across the road, a tiny Inari shrine. It shares a name with Inari-senpai.
strings.item.c_bike_bell.name: Bicycle Bell
strings.item.c_bike_bell.hint: Lying in a corner of the parking lot north of the library.
strings.item.c_greenhouse_seed.name: Greenhouse Seed Packet
strings.item.c_greenhouse_seed.hint: Between the growing benches in the greenhouse. An unlabelled seed packet behind a pot.
strings.item.c_gym_whistle.name: Gymnasium Whistle
strings.item.c_gym_whistle.hint: At the far end of the gym arena, on top of a vaulting box in the equipment store.
strings.item.c_library_bookmark.name: Closed-Stacks Bookmark
strings.item.c_library_bookmark.hint: The library's open shelves, the last of the fourteen rows. Slipped between two books.
strings.item.c_dome_key.name: Octagonal Dome Key
strings.item.c_dome_key.hint: The library's second-floor gallery, by the railing over the atrium. It seems to open the rooftop hall.
strings.item.c_kyoso_tumbler.name: Kyoso Hall Tumbler
strings.item.c_kyoso_tumbler.hint: The second-floor lounge of Kyoso Hall. On the lost-and-found shelf, a tumbler patterned like the white louvres.
strings.item.c_kyoso_sticker.name: Campus Store Sticker
strings.item.c_kyoso_sticker.hint: Beside the register of the Kyoso Hall store. One leftover promotional sticker.
strings.item.c_lecture_chalk.name: Great Hall Chalk
strings.item.c_lecture_chalk.hint: The control booth above the lecture building's great hall. One stick of chalk nobody uses any more.
strings.item.c_lecture_notebook.name: Forgotten Seminar Notebook
strings.item.c_lecture_notebook.hint: A seminar room in the lecture building. Inside a desk, a notebook with nothing on the cover.
strings.item.c_tray_charm.name: Tray-Return Charm
strings.item.c_tray_charm.hint: The tray return in the Research Building 2 cafeteria. Sitting on top of the stack of trays.
strings.item.c_notice_magnet.name: Notice Board Magnet
strings.item.c_notice_magnet.hint: The notice board in the Research Building 1 lobby. One magnet holding nothing up.
strings.item.c_lab_goggles.name: Lab Goggles
strings.item.c_lab_goggles.hint: The far lab in Experiment Building 1. Left next to the fume hood.
strings.item.c_lab_beaker.name: Faded Beaker
strings.item.c_lab_beaker.hint: The lab in Experiment Building 2. On the bench by the chemical cabinet, a beaker with its markings almost gone.
strings.item.c_greenhouse_sprout.name: Greenhouse Sprout
strings.item.c_greenhouse_sprout.hint: Proof of helping with greenhouse duty. A tiny pot with only two leaves so far.
strings.item.c_sora_charm.name: Sora's Test-Tube Charm
strings.item.c_sora_charm.hint: A test-tube charm from Sora. It looks like there's blue liquid inside.
strings.item.c_inari_bookmark.name: Inari's Second Bookmark
strings.item.c_inari_bookmark.hint: Inari-senpai's second pressed-flower bookmark. This one is made from a park leaf, not a pool leaf.
strings.photo.ps_mall_view.name: Down the Mall
strings.photo.ps_mall_view.caption: From the gate end, 250 metres of paving run straight to the library.
strings.photo.ps_pond_library.name: Library in the Pool
strings.photo.ps_pond_library.caption: Only on windless days do the deep eaves and the octagonal dome fit whole in the water.
strings.photo.ps_kyoso_facade.name: Kyoso Hall Louvres
strings.photo.ps_kyoso_facade.caption: White vertical louvres on the building finished in 2025. In the afternoon the shadows turn to stripes.
strings.photo.ps_gym_catwalk.name: Arena from the Catwalk
strings.photo.ps_gym_catwalk.caption: Light from the high side windows lays long bands across the floor, afternoons only.
strings.photo.ps_library_gallery.name: Reading Room from the Gallery
strings.photo.ps_library_gallery.caption: From the second-floor gallery, seven rows of reading tables across the atrium.
strings.photo.ps_lecture_atrium.name: Grand Stair Hall
strings.photo.ps_lecture_atrium.caption: Inside the curved corner. A three-storey grand stair that is the flow of people made solid.
